title: Planet Tweaks V2.9.9 NOVA TITAN 🪐 — Remodeled Pre-Launch Builder, 2-Column Performance Engines, True NKRO Scanner & Permanent Vault
releaseNotes: Planet Tweaks V2.9.9 NOVA TITAN: (1) Remodeled 🚀 Pre-Launch Routine Builder: Close Background Apps strictly shows ONLY currently running apps on your PC (zero uninstalled clutter + live Refresh), Open Apps & Shortcuts deduplicates every app to 1 clean row with zero [Start Menu] spam, launches normally via Windows Shell with 0% background overhead, and adds gray-to-red ✕ remove buttons wired to Deleted Tabs + '+ Add App / Shortcut'. (2) Remodeled ⚙️ Settings -> Performance Engines: clean 2-Column Hardware Switch Grid separating Input Hooks & Latency Engines from Startup & Optional Modules with live 0.00ms Pure Native / Hook Active telemetry and 1-click Zero-Overhead Trim. (3) Upgraded ⌨️ Live Anti-Ghosting Matrix: combined Win32 GetAsyncKeyState hardware scanning + low-level keyboard/mouse hooks (even on remapped keys) with live True NKRO / 6KRO / 3-5 Key Cluster rollover diagnostics. (4) Permanent 🗑️ Deleted Tabs & Pre-Launch Vault: fixed workspace_layout.json overwriting saved DeletedTweaks across updates, pinned Deleted Tabs permanently in the sidebar, and added Section 3 to restore removed Pre-Launch apps anytime. (5) Cleaned up duplicate Unstick Keys buttons.
